findings.what: Offered slot is not held during the 30-minute offer window; an online booker can take it and the accept then voids the offer.

acceptOffer claims the offer, creates the appointment and updates the entry in separate non-transactional steps; a crash in between leaves the offer accepted with no appointment and the entry stuck as offered.
Offer expiry and pass-on rely on the 5-minute cron sweep, so the next patient can get the offer up to ~35 minutes after the first was sent.
Recording leave ignores the waitlist: pending offers and waiting entries on leave dates are not voided or notified; offers fail only at accept time and entries stay queued forever.
findFreeDoctors checks only the start slot with isRegularSlot, and the unique index covers only start_time, so overlapping multi-slot services rely on a read-then-check (same as the v1 pattern).
